title: flexfetch configuration
description: Schema for ~/.config/flexfetch/config.toml (also ./flexfetch.toml and --config). Schema version 1. Auto-migrated on load; see ROADMAP 8.3.

version.description: Config schema version (not the app version). Must be <= the flexfetch binary's CURRENT_SCHEMA (1). Omit for legacy v1 files.

modules.description: Ordered module list. Recognized names: title, separator, os, host, kernel, uptime, locale, cpu, cpucache, cpuusage, memory, swap, disk, gpu, network, dns, display, bluetooth, media, battery, temperature, processes, packages, shell, terminal, de, wm, colors, custom, publicip, wifi, git, project, context, health, weather, container, wallpaper, fsdeep, resolution.

plugins_dir.description: Directory containing Lua plugins (optional; defaults to ~/.config/flexfetch/plugins).

template.description: Template name (default) or path to a .tera file.

theme.description: Theme preset name, 'random', 'auto' (wallpaper), or 'none'. Presets: catppuccin, dracula, nord, gruvbox, tokyo-night, solarized-dark/light, rose-pine(-dawn), everforest-dark/light, bamboo, oxocarbon-dark, one-dark/light, tokyo-night-storm, catppuccin-mocha/frappe/macchiato, monokai(-pro), ayu-dark/mirage, palenight, material-ocean, kanagawa, mellow-purple.

color_title.description: ANSI color name or escape for the title.

gradient_colors.description: Hex colors (#rrggbb) for the title gradient.

sections.description: Group rows under section headers (fastfetch style).

ttl.description: Cache TTL in seconds for network-backed modules (publicip, weather).

command.description: Shell command whose stdout becomes the value.

custom.description: Custom modules: name -> { command, label?, shell? }.
